WITH RECURSIVE
    reachable(src, dst) AS (
        SELECT a.atom_id, a.atom_id
        FROM atom a
        UNION ALL
        SELECT r.src, c.atom_id2
        FROM reachable r
        JOIN connected c ON r.dst = c.atom_id
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM reachable r2
            WHERE r2.src = r.src AND r2.dst = c.atom_id2
        )
    ),
    component AS (
        SELECT src AS atom_id,
               (SELECT MIN(dst) FROM reachable r WHERE r.src = a.atom_id) AS comp_id
        FROM atom a
    ),
    comp_stats AS (
        SELECT comp.comp_id,
               COUNT(DISTINCT comp.atom_id) AS atom_count,
               COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)   AS bond_count
        FROM component comp
        JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = comp.atom_id
        LEFT JOIN connected cn ON cn.atom_id = a.atom_id
        LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = cn.bond_id
        GROUP BY comp.comp_id
    ),
    largest AS (
        SELECT comp_id, atom_count, bond_count
        FROM comp_stats
        ORDER BY atom_count DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
SELECT CASE WHEN atom_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (bond_count * 1.0) / atom_count END AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM largest;
